title: Recover From A Protected Range Refusal
task: Using docxedit only, inspect the private input copy for a bookmark or complex-field range spanning more than one paragraph.

Attempt a generic replace-text edit wholly inside the range by targeting an interior paragraph ID and record the refusal diagnostic code; a refusal is the expected safe outcome, so do not force the edit.
Recover by editing text outside the range with an appropriate expect guard; keep the recovery to the outside-range edit the diagnostics point at.
Run docxedit check before each apply and write the edited .docx under the run directory.
Validate the final output with docxedit read and docxedit validate, confirming the range markup survived.
If no multi-paragraph range exists, stop after the inspection and check attempts and report the range classes found without private text.
successCriteria: Shows the interior generic replace-text edit refused with a protection diagnostic before any recovery.
Produces an output .docx where only the outside-range text changed.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the refusal diagnostic name the protected feature and the safe alternative?
Could the agent distinguish interior targets from range endpoints?
Did the output validation confirm the range markup survived?
applicability: Requires a bookmark or complex-field range spanning more than one paragraph; without one, stop after the inspection and check attempts. That path is not-applicable, not success.
